negative_control.claim: Q/E/R have end-to-end authority only on the local headless path; on the native protocol path the request degrades to a primary attack and no authoritative skill feedback returns

chain.fact: server reads payload key 'skillId', so native requests always fall back to 'primary-attack'; no test drives thrust/sweep/war-cry through ProtocolSession

even with the key fixed the handler never dispatches the action: start_player_attack discards power ((void)player_attack) and advance_combat stamps every hit skill_id='primary-attack'; no cost/cooldown/cone/area/buff on this path

no authoritative feedback: protocol snapshots carry no player resource/cooldown fields, client model hardcodes resource=50/50, ClientPlayer has no cooldown field, war-cry never mapped remotely so quickbar availability renders from defaults

negative_control.related_deviation: RMB contracted as D-007 weapon skill but bound to Dash identical to Space; no distinct RMB weapon skill exists (orchestration/DECISIONS.md:33 vs native/client/main.cpp:4104-4107)
